reviews.text: Excellent welcome and care for my cat's first consultation. The vet took the time to explain everything thoroughly. I know my cat will be well looked after during his first year. I'm already looking forward to coming back in a month.
First consultation for my kitten Yuzu. Thank you to Dr. Florence for her professionalism; she guided me and explained all the medical and nutritional information. I highly recommend her. :)

Absolutely love this 100% cat clinic!

We stumbled upon it by chance while passing by. The welcome was incredibly warm, and the team was attentive and caring with our cat… and with us. They really take their time, without rushing.
I 100% recommend them! 😻

Thank you so much for taking a few minutes to post this positive review!

We hope that owners' support of the "Cat Friendly" concept helps us provide even better medical care for our feline friends!

The Team at Clinique Mon Chat et Moi Lyon 3

Superb clinic! 😻 The team is professional, attentive, and very gentle with cats. My cat feels comfortable there for his appointments; he's calm and gets lots of treats!

A big thank you to Dr. Lemarie who, thanks to her feline expertise, has stabilized my cat Bambou's seizures.
My cat fell from the 3rd floor. Thank you to the whole team for taking care of Simba despite his temperament. It's thanks to you and your kindness that he's back home; you saved his life!

Good evening Mr. Fanget, and thank you so much for taking a few minutes to post this review!

We are delighted to have met Yaksha, who, despite her shy demeanor, is a very sweet old cat!

We wish her many more years with you!

Have a lovely evening;

The Team at Clinique Mon Chat et Moi Lyon 3.

I really enjoyed going to this clinic (well, if you can call it that, because you never really want to take your cat to the vet) where the staff is kind and full of thoughtful touches. You feel reassured... the premises are beautiful and make you feel comfortable. Most importantly, you can leave your cat with complete confidence thanks to Dr. Lemarié. She takes the time to explain everything and even took the initiative to ask me to come earlier so she could perform a minor surgical procedure the same day, so I wouldn't have to bring my cat, who is extremely stressed, back. Thank you for your very much appreciated kindness.
A great deal of kindness and professionalism. A very well-maintained office where you feel comfortable! I highly recommend it.

I brought my cat in for an emergency appointment due to a suspected leg fracture, and I highly recommend this veterinary clinic. The welcome is warm and friendly. The vet was lovely, and the entire team took excellent care of Achille. Thank you for your wonderful care!
I was very warmly welcomed by the courteous and friendly team, thank you.
Thank you for your kindness and advice.

This clinic ticks all the boxes. The staff is very friendly; as soon as you walk in, you feel right at home. They offer a health program, which is great for managing costs, especially if, like me, you have a pet that needs regular checkups. The vet didn't hesitate to answer all our questions and gave us excellent advice. Honestly, I went there with some apprehension, thinking it would be like other veterinary clinics, a bit of an assembly line, but absolutely not! The staff takes the time for each cat. You can go there with complete confidence. The best part? My cat wasn't intimidated by the place at all, except maybe by the bird on the wallpaper in the examination room, haha.

We came in urgently because our young cat had fallen from the balcony. We were greeted with great kindness and compassion.

A huge thank you for your prompt attention.
My big teddy bear cat Rocky was very well cared for. Thank you for receiving him so quickly.

Having been looking for a new veterinarian for some time after bad experiences with my previous one, I was recommended this clinic for its expertise and the gentleness of the staff with both cats and humans.

My little furball was examined with incredible gentleness and patience—and for the first time ever, she felt relaxed in front of a vet. Dr. Lemarié diagnosed and treated far more in two appointments than my previous vet had in four years.

The entire team is lovely, very reassuring, and allows you and your pet to take all the time you and your pet need. The explanations are clear, and we are given space to ask questions, express concerns, and be reassured.

The entire reception and consultation area is very calming, for both humans and cats.

This is the first time in my life as a cat owner that I've left a vet visit feeling reassured, and for all these reasons, I will, of course, continue my little furball's medical care at this clinic.

Thank you for everything you do and for your love of cats which is felt throughout the clinic 🤍🙏

I 100% recommend this practice. It's a calm and peaceful place. Veterinarian Florence Lemarié immediately put my cat at ease. The handling and treatments were done gently to avoid any stress, and the 30-minute appointments allow for plenty of time.

I had a visit for my little cat who'd had diarrhea for almost two months! We called our usual vet and got just some treatment advice over the phone, then after a brief appointment that cost us €300, they did a blood test and changed her food (she'd had diarrhea for three weeks already)... I called back after 10 days and they said, "Oh well, wait a little longer..." I was getting really frustrated, and I'd gotten my cat's and my contact information from Facebook with good reviews from other vets in other cities... I booked online (like Doctolib, where you can choose your appointments!) because, yes, they're open on Saturdays for people who work during the week! So great! And Dr. Lemarie listened to us carefully, asked lots of questions, examined our cat, and yes, she kept her to find and list everything she might have! Ultrasound, tests (the vet called us before ordering any additional paid tests to avoid any surprises compared to the initial quote, and we could pay in installments), and she finally found the source of the problem... we paid almost the same as the other vet for more tests and to find out what was wrong with our cat!!!! Phew... and as a bonus, a little coffee was offered while we waited for our appointment, and we keep each other updated on Elise's health by phone, unlike the other vet where if things aren't back to normal, you have to bring her back, yes, for another €300... lol... anyway, I recommend her 1000%! Elise will now be a regular customer at "My Cat and Me"!!!!!

A team of professionals who are caring towards both animals and their owners. Empathy, clear explanations, and invaluable advice—I highly recommend this clinic! Thank you for the care you gave my Oreo.

A veterinarian just as you'd imagine: compassionate with animals, patient with their owners, and above all, competent and flexible in providing the best possible care. Plus, a wonderful veterinary assistant who is both helpful and reassuring. A huge thank you from my cats and me!

I highly recommend this veterinary practice because I've seen many others before who prioritized profit over saving my little darlings.

The best veterinary team in Lyon! Dr. Lemarié and Margaux have taken excellent care of our two cats and continue to do so. They are passionate and completely devoted to our feline friends. I highly recommend them!

I came to this clinic after passing by by chance, and after several years of owning cats and visiting different clinics in various cities, I can easily say that this one is the best! From the reception and the consultation to the follow-up care, the team, and the clinic itself, everything is fantastic!
Everything has been designed with the cat's well-being in mind, and it really shows. As new clients, we're welcomed with a booklet that explains everything there is to know about our cat, as well as insurance options. We're also offered water while we wait, with soft background music playing, and the cat even gets a little welcome ball. But what really impressed me here is the follow-up and attention given to both the cat and its owner! It's the first time I've seen a veterinarian who truly takes the time during a consultation, explains things so well, is reassuring, and goes into detail so that everything is easy to understand. When my cat had to spend the night at the clinic, they even sent me updates by message with a photo – I'd never experienced that before! This clinic and its team are truly wonderful, and I now recommend it to all my friends who are cat owners. ☺️

I highly recommend this clinic! Florence Lemarié is a wonderful veterinarian: gentle, caring, and passionate. She has always taken excellent care of my two fur babies. Her professionalism, expertise, and know-how allow her to find the best solutions for various health problems.

She also takes the time to support both you and your cat, as it's always very stressful to see your four-legged companion sick. Her attentiveness, availability, and empathy make all the difference. I have complete confidence in her and sincerely thank her for everything she does.

My Mynos is very lucky to have such a dedicated, caring, and attentive veterinarian. A huge thank you for everything!

I called in an emergency for my cat and got an appointment very quickly. The vet is incredibly gentle, kind, and particularly attentive to animals. You can tell she practices her profession with passion and compassion.

The reception is always very warm, and the whole team is smiling, available, and attentive. It's a practice where you feel confident from the moment you arrive. A huge thank you for your professionalism, your responsiveness, and the excellent care given to my cat. I highly recommend them.

I thank the entire team for their responsiveness regarding my cat, who was suffering at the end of her life. They offered me an appointment the same day and gave me the time I needed with her. They are very kind and gentle people who knew how to take the time with me and my friend. Thank you to them for their humanity and professionalism.

Ohhhh, this isn't just a veterinary clinic, it's a magnificent place where everything is designed for the cat and its owners! A zen atmosphere. Top-notch personalized service. Attentive and full of advice. Florence took the time and was very gentle in making our kitty feel at ease. Thank you to the whole team for your kindness. I recommend it 200%!

Thank you for everything!

A very pleasant clinic, for my cat and for me!

The vet is friendly, and their opening hours (especially Saturday afternoons) are very convenient. It might seem a little expensive, but the fact that the clinic is exclusively for cats justifies the price and helps keep your pet calm :)
Attentive and very professional

Hello and thank you so much for taking a few minutes to share your experience following your visit for your little darling.

We hope she enjoys many happy years with you!

See you soon!

The Team at Clinique Mon Chat et Moi Lyon 3

Fantastic! Dr. Lemarié is as wonderful as ever, so gentle with my cat.

Thank you.

Hello!

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave your review on Google!

We are so happy to welcome Taro as one of our new little patients! We wish you a long and wonderful journey with him!

See you soon!

The Mon Chat et Moi Lyon 3 Team

A specialized cat clinic, making it a must for cat owners! Our little guy's first visit was a great success. He was quickly reassured by the calming environment and the very friendly doctor.
Everything went well.

A truly comprehensive monitoring system; the explanations are clear, and the veterinary medical team is genuinely there for the animal. The atmosphere is calm and friendly, both for us and for the cat.
The team's responsiveness, professionalism, and kindness were greatly appreciated; I thank them again warmly for their care and advice.

Thank you for this very positive review! Please feel free to leave a short message so we can identify you and reply personally!

The Team at Clinique Mon Chat et Moi Lyon 3
Excellent veterinary clinic, I recommend it to anyone who has a cat.
I really liked this place :). It's very calm, professional, and the staff are really friendly.

I took Arceus in for a pre-adoption check-up (I'm a foster family).
The clinic is really nice, and so is the vet. Thank you for the welcome.

My experience was perfect and reassuring.
The staff were kind and took the time to answer all my questions. My little Elio even fell asleep because he was so comfortable and at ease. I recommend this veterinary clinic 100%.

If you don't know where to take your kittens, this is the best place there is for them. They give each cat their own special attention, which makes all the difference.
1000% recommended!

I highly recommend this clinic! The premises are very pleasant, tastefully decorated, and thoughtfully designed down to the smallest detail, including the dedicated cage area for the small patients: a calm, dimly lit room that is both soothing and welcoming.

The team, both at reception and among the veterinarians, was exceptionally professional, caring, and attentive. There are no rushed consultations here; instead, they take the time for a genuine conversation, with a thoughtful and high-quality approach! 🌼

Hello!

Thank you for this wonderful review, which encourages us to continue with passion on the path we have chosen: supporting cats and their owners with kindness and care while offering the highest quality medical treatment possible.
Have a lovely day.

The Team at Clinique Mon Chat et Moi Lyon 3.

Excellent!
I was very happy with this appointment; the vet gave good advice and reassured me.

A very positive experience for my cat Simba and me during his first visit for vaccinations. The place is calm and soothing for both my cat and me. The service is personalized, gentle, and thorough. Very satisfied!

I highly recommend her!
Florence is gentle, caring, and very kind. She takes her time, is attentive, and gives excellent advice. I sincerely thank her, and so does my little Austin!
The vet was incredibly responsive, thank you so much for taking such good care of my pet.

A very pleasant new clinic, both for us cat lovers and for ourselves. The place is calm and pretty, very soothing.

The team is very welcoming and attentive to everyone's well-being.
I highly recommend it!

Called in the morning for a dental abscess. Appointment scheduled for the same day and surgery the following day.

Thank you again for your welcome, your attentive listening, and your advice for my little "senior" furball.

First visit to this clinic and I highly recommend it!

For context, it was a major check-up for my 15-year-old senior cat, who has arthritis.

We were guided and informed in detail about the necessary care for my cat, using a program that allows us to convert the year's services into monthly payments (which avoids a large upfront expense!).

We have some tests to do, but I'm reassured to have year-round monitoring for my cat 🐱

Who, by the way, was very well received and wasn't stressed or mishandled!

Thank you!
